Maria: Quick follow-up to the alloc-hint RFC — proposing a small API tweak for persistent-pin hints so the runtime can know expected lifetime, access pattern, and whether to avoid compaction. TL;DR: give hints for long-lived-hot vs long-lived-cold so we can pick host-compress vs keep-in-GPU strategies.

Sam: Can you paste the proposed signature?

Maria: ```rust
pub enum LifetimeHint { Short, Medium, Long }
pub enum AccessPattern { Random, Sequential, ReadHeavy, WriteHeavy }
pub struct AllocHint {
  lifetime: LifetimeHint,
  access: Option<AccessPattern>,
  avoid_compaction: bool,
  expected_reads: Option<u32> // best-effort
}
// alloc(owner, size, AllocHint)
```

Julian: Hmm. avoid_compaction = true + lifetime = Long seems risky for fragmentation. How do we reclaim in emergencies? :thinking:

Maria: Good call. Plan is soft-demote windows + eviction-score penalty instead of absolute pin. Also an admin override to force demote/compact. The hint only biases admission/placement, not absolute immutability.

Kai: Also need to consider NUMA-affinity for host-backed pages. Long-lived but cold should favor host-compress and remote NUMA nodes rather than pinning local GPU-backed host pages.

Dinesh: I think the API mixes two orthogonal concerns: residency (how long/where) and compaction policy. I'd split into ResidencyHint vs CompactionHint to keep allocator logic simpler.

Sam: Splitting makes sense. But it increases per-alloc knobs which we need to limit. Recommend default presets: "hot-long", "cold-long", "ephemeral-short".

Olivia: +1 on presets. Also we should add telemetry dims before rollout: alloc_hint_effectiveness{preset, tenant, model, outcome} and a latency-regression tag. We need metrics to prove benefit.

Maria: Agreed. Rollout plan I propose: 1) telemetry-only (no change to placement), 2) soft-apply (hints are advisory, evictors can ignore under pressure), 3) enforce for specific tenants/queues after 2-4 weeks of stable signals.

Julian: Nit: ensure avoid_compaction isn't advertised to Private customers by default (enterprise policies might want different defaults).

Kai: Also double-check interactions with KV cache and KV-attach. Pinned allocations that hold KV cache entries should get higher priority for GPU residency.

Dinesh: I'll prototype a demote worker that treats (lifetime=Long && avoid_compaction) as "sticky-cold" after 24h idle and moves to host-compressed store instead of full eviction. That should mitigate fragmentation while honoring hints.

Sam: We need perf experiments: microbench with mixed inference workload (tiny batches, large chat, embeddings) and fragmentation trace comparison. I can spin up canary.

infra-bot: deploy-successful: canary/alloc-hint-telemetry 2026-03-20T02:14:00Z :rocket:

Maria: OK I'll update the RFC with: split ResidencyHint/CompactionHint, presets, telemetry schema, rollout steps, and admin override CLI. Also keep binary alloc syscall backward-compatible (`alloc2`) and map new hints internally.

Julian: One more: document expected complexity of allocator state changes. We should guard compaction to avoid large p99 latency regressions during concurrent compaction + inference.

Kai: Agreed. Add a compaction-rate limiter tied to throughput SLOs.

Maria: I'll add the limiter and a short experiment matrix in the RFC. Opening PR with tests + bench by EOD Friday. Thanks all :thumbsup:
